business_purpose: Respond to the owner's explicit visual rejection by replacing the washed-out wireframe-like A+ V1 with a materially stronger, brand-specific, commercial-grade art direction for /v2/home before any production implementation is authorized.
raw_data_boundary: No merchant raw rows, buyer data, orders, addresses, phone numbers, after-sales notes, source filenames, or live credentials are used. The isolated prototype uses deterministic masked values and must visibly state that it is not business evidence.
decision_questions: Does the new composition feel like a premium Airburg product rather than a sparse wireframe or generic SaaS template?
Does the first screen establish strong visual tension, decision hierarchy, and material contrast without becoming an all-dark BI wall?
Can the operator still locate all 17 KPI and distinguish missing data from zero?
Is the new art direction strong enough for the owner to authorize a separate production design-system and implementation task?

allowed: A full aesthetic rebase for /v2/home only
One isolated high-fidelity standalone prototype with exact draft brand tokens
The approved 17 KPI labels and missing-value behavior
Root-cause critique, art-direction specification, validation report, and handoff
forbidden: Production app, component, library, type, package, deployment, or route edits
Formula, metric semantic, ETL, persistence, real-data adapter, or SSOT changes
Hiding, renaming, fabricating, or silently deprioritizing required KPI
Using the rejected A+ V1 as an accepted visual reference
Deploying, pushing, redirecting /home, or claiming commercial or human acceptance

unknowns: The final Airburg SaaS logo asset and licensed product typeface are still unavailable; the prototype must use a clearly provisional wordmark.
The four-featured-metric hierarchy still requires a visual-contract amendment before implementation.
Top-tier aesthetic quality remains a human judgment and cannot be proven by DOM or screenshot checks.
The prototype will not prove real-route accessibility, performance, permissions, localization, empty, loading, or error behavior.
validation_plan: Render the isolated prototype directly at 1440x900 and a 390px review surface using its exact draft palette and material system.
Confirm 17 unique KPI, three unavailable KPI displayed as --, visible masked-demo disclosure, and no unsafe token leakage.
Confirm no root horizontal overflow at 1440, 390, and 320 review widths.
Confirm primary view switching and data-health detail interaction update accessible states without console errors.
Separate aesthetic review readiness from production, accessibility, performance, human acceptance, and commercial release.
